title: The pitcher plant: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: The leaves of a pitcher plant are shaped like deep cups.
Pitcher plants often grow in rich soil.
Some pitcher plants make sweet nectar.
The edge of the pitcher is sticky.
At the bottom of the pitcher, there is sand.
The plant uses special juices to break the insect down.
What are the deep cups of this plant called?
Why does the pitcher plant catch insects?
options: Because the soil does not give it enough nutrients
items.why: “The soil does not give them enough nutrients.”

items.q: How does the plant attract insects?
options: With bright colors and a sweet smell
items.why: “The plant may have bright colors. It may smell sweet.”

items.q: Why can't the insect get out?
options: The plant holds it with its leaves
The walls are smooth and hard to climb
The pitcher closes like a box
items.why: “Inside, the walls are smooth and hard to climb.”

items.q: What can a pitcher plant also be for some very small animals?
items.why: “Sometimes it can also be a tiny home.”

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: The pitcher plant grows in poor soil, so it catches insects to get nutrients. It attracts them with bright colors and a sweet smell, and they fall into its slippery pitcher. Then the plant digests them and absorbs the nutrients.

items.q: What happens when an insect lands on the edge of the pitcher?
items.model: The edge is slippery, so the insect loses its footing and falls into the pitcher.

items.q: How does the plant get nutrients from the insect?
items.model: It uses special juices to break the insect down. The insect becomes nutrients, and the plant absorbs them.

items.q: Why is the pitcher plant "not only a trap"?
items.model: Because sometimes it can also be a tiny home for some very small animals.

items.q: Which plant or animal do you find the most surprising? Why?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the steps in the order of the text.
items: The plant attracts an insect with color and sweetness
The insect lands on the slippery edge
The insect falls into the pitcher
The plant breaks the insect down with special juices
